explanation: Iron is more reactive than copper, so it displaces copper from copper sulfate solution, forming iron sulfate and depositing metallic copper.

beaker_view.initial_appearance: A grey iron nail dropped into a deep blue copper sulphate solution.
beaker_view.final_appearance: A pale green iron sulphate solution, with the nail now coated in a reddish-brown layer of deposited copper.
beaker_view.observation: Over about twenty minutes, the solution's deep blue colour visibly fades toward pale green as the nail picks up a reddish copper coating.
